_comment: Alpe d'Huez corrections. Dome des Petites Rousses / Lac Blanc sector (top of the 'Alpette-Rousses' cable car): the elevation source we use (open-elevation, which reproduces eudem25m here exactly) has a localised void at the cable-car top station and its immediate neighbour, reading them ~45-50 m too LOW. Two independent DEMs (opentopodata srtm30m and mapzen) agree with each other to the metre and disagree with eudem by 45 m at n251684113 and 50 m at n11724215777, while agreeing with eudem to within 3-9 m at every surrounding node - a void confined to the station shelf, not real terrain. The consequence was severe: the top station read 2757 m while the bowl it serves read 2787-2798 m, so the station sat 30 m BELOW its own ski terrain. That forced the station<->bowl connector one-way DOWNHILL (bowl -> station), which left the whole bowl drainable but unenterable - 13 nodes permanently orphaned, and a cable car whose top station had no descending piste at all. Correcting the two void nodes to the srtm30m/mapzen consensus puts the station at 2802 m and the bowl portal at 2804 m, a 2 m rise over 55 m; that is inside maxTraverseClimb, so the connector becomes bidirectional and the bowl gains an entrance while keeping its exit. n7779237420 is corrected to the same consensus (2804) because it sits 55 m from the station on the same dome and is inside the same void's shadow (eudem 2787 vs 2804); the resort operator's own figure for this high point is ~2810, which corroborates the srtm/mapzen reading over eudem's. Nodes outside the void (the lower bowl at 2702-2777) are deliberately left alone - there the two DEMs differ by only 3-9 m, which is ordinary noise, and re-sampling them would fabricate micro-pitches.
